info.title: Perafly API
info.description: Publish folders as versioned projects. Errors use RFC 9457 (application/problem+json) with a stable `code`.

get.summary: Built-in agent sessions of the team (full sign-in only)

post.summary: Start the built-in agent: it builds and publishes a preview version. Spends agent credits up to the budget

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Replays the first response for 24 hours

get.summary: One agent session
Conversation and progress of an agent session, oldest first; pass after=<seq> for new events

post.summary: Send a message to the agent
Stop what the agent is doing
Change the session budget; a paused session continues
Allow or deny a command the agent is waiting on

get.summary: This period's plan, usage, overage, spend limit and agent credits. Buying and plan changes happen in the Perafly panel
Identity behind the credential: team key (team, role, permissions) or project key (its project)

post.summary: Start a device sign-in (RFC 8628); the user approves at verificationUri
Exchange an approved device code for a CLI API key (once). 400 authorization_pending | slow_down | access_denied | expired_token
Exchange a one-time handoff link (pfh_…) for an agent key limited to one project

token.description: The handoff link or its pfh_… token

get.summary: List the team's API keys (needs keys.manage; not available to agent credentials)

post.summary: Create an API key; the secret is returned once (needs keys.manage)

get.summary: Status of an action waiting for a teammate's approval

post.summary: Result of an approved action. 409 approval_pending while undecided, 403 approval_declined, 410 approval_expired. Never start the action again instead
Revoke the calling API key

get.summary: List projects (a project key sees only its project)

post.summary: Create an empty project

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Replays the first response for 24 hours

get.summary: Get a project

patch.summary: Rename, retitle or change the publish rule

delete.summary: Delete a project (confirmName must equal its name)

post.summary: Declare files for a new version; returns upload URLs for missing files. Without credentials a new ownerless project is created and its project key is returned once

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Replays the first response for 24 hours

put.summary: Upload one file's bytes to a signed upload URL

post.summary: Finalize uploads and deploy; waits until ready (up to `wait` seconds)

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Replays the first response for 24 hours

get.summary: List versions (newest first)
Get a version

delete.summary: Delete a version that is not live

post.summary: Make a ready version live (also used to roll back); no rebuild. With an agent credential: 403 approval_required and an execution to resume after approval

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Replays the first response for 24 hours

get.summary: List a version's files
Build log of a version (latest by default)
Who can open the project: public or private, share link, password, people and pending access requests

put.summary: Make the project public or private (needs share.manage and a full-access key; agents can't change access)

post.summary: Create a share link (the URL is returned once; it replaces the previous link)
Share the project with a person by email (they sign in to Perafly with that address)

get.summary: Custom domains of the project with status and the DNS records to set

post.summary: Connect a custom domain; returns the DNS records to set. Counts toward the plan's domain limit
Check verification and DNS now

get.summary: Which project (and version) a Perafly address belongs to: live, version (--vN), branch preview (--br-), custom domain or storage file URL. Only projects this credential can see; anything else is not_found
Search the Perafly docs (guides, API operations, error codes). Every word must match; results link to perafly.com/docs (no credentials needed)
Public plans with prices, included usage, limits and features (no credentials needed)
Collections of the project's headless data layer with their schema, rules and record counts

post.summary: Create a collection: name, fields, access rules and optional change hook. The first collection also creates the publishable key

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Replays the first response for 24 hours

get.summary: One collection

patch.summary: Change fields (the full list), rules or the change hook. A field's type cannot change; making read, update or delete public needs a person, not an agent

delete.summary: Delete a collection and its records

get.summary: Export every record as CSV or JSON (a file). Not with the publishable key
List records. filter[field]=value or filter[field][gte]=… (eq, ne, gt, gte, lt, lte, in) and sort=-createdAt on indexed and system fields. Counts toward the monthly data requests

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: filter[field]=value or filter[field][op]=value (eq, ne, gt, gte, lt, lte, in)

post.summary: Add a record (the body is the record's fields). With the publishable key only when the collection's create rule is public

get.summary: One record

patch.summary: Change some fields; null removes a field

get.summary: The project's publishable key and whether a secret key and webhook secret exist (the secret is never shown again)

post.summary: Replace the publishable key; the old one stops working at once. Needs keys.manage and a person's key
Create or replace the secret key; returned once. It becomes the PERAFLY_SECRET_KEY environment variable from the next version. Needs keys.manage and a person's key

get.summary: The last 50 change hook deliveries
Environment variables, including the system ones. Sensitive values are never returned

put.summary: Add or change a variable; applies from the next version. Not with an agent profile

get.summary: Files and folders under a prefix (public/ or private/)

delete.summary: Delete a file (?path=) or a folder (?prefix=, up to 1000 files)

post.summary: Get a signed upload URL for one file; PUT the bytes there. Checks the plan's storage limits

get.summary: A file's details and a signed download URL (15 minutes)

post.summary: Move or rename a file, or a folder when from ends with /

put.summary: The file's bytes (exactly the declared size)

get.summary: The file itself
SFTP accounts, the host and port to connect to, and whether the plan includes SFTP

post.summary: Open an SFTP account with an SSH public key or a generated password (returned once). Paid plans; needs keys.manage and a person's key

get.summary: Git connection and settings: GitHub repository, production branch, automatic deploys and the direct push address

put.summary: Connect a GitHub repository (from the team's installations) or change branch settings. Turning on automatic production deploys needs versions.promote

delete.summary: Disconnect the GitHub repository; versions and branch previews stay

get.summary: The last 50 Git builds

post.summary: Approve a pull request build from a fork; it gets the project's environment variables

get.summary: Branch preview addresses and the version each one serves
Access, runtime and build logs, newest first; pass after=<cursor> to follow new lines (oldest first). Older than the plan's retention is cut (truncated: true)

Traffic (requests, page views, visitors, bandwidth, status codes, top paths) and runtime metrics (invocations, duration, CPU, memory). Unmeasured values are null; runsCode false means the project runs no code
The team's projects ranked by requests in the range, with errors, bandwidth, visitors, invocations and build seconds
Status of a long-running operation

post.summary: Move an ownerless project into the key's team; optionally mint a project-scoped agent key (returned once)

get.summary: This document

projectKey.description: Project key of an ownerless project (`pfc_…`): read, publish, finalize, versions, promote — only its project

publishableKey.description: Publishable data key (`pfp_…`): lives in the browser; only record actions whose rule is public

secretKey.description: Secret data key (`pfk_…`): server side; the project's records, collections (read) and storage

oauth.description: OAuth 2.1 with PKCE for the hosted MCP server; access tokens `pfo_…`

scopes.agent: Publish and manage projects; risky actions wait for approval

token.description: `pfa_…` CLI key: 30 days, invalid after 7 days unused

approval.description: Set when an agent's publish over the live version waits for approval

git.description: Git source: trigger (github, push, ci), branch, commit { sha, message, author }, pullRequest, branchUrl (the branch preview address this version was published to; null for live and production builds)

AgentEvent.description: type: user.message, agent.message, agent.tool, agent.thread, preview, outcome, status, error

state.description: blocked: new builds are paused (live sites keep serving)

access.description: First access of a project this publish creates (not for an existing project or without an account). Public in a team that keeps new sites private needs sharing permission and a full-access key (403 access_change_forbidden)

git.description: From CI: the branch decides live or preview (production branch) and the branch preview address when target is not given

projectKey.description: Only when an ownerless project is created: `pfc_…`, shown once

traffic.description: requests, pageViews, visitors, bytes, status, errorRate, cacheHitRate, series, topPaths, topReferrers (null when not measured)

runtime.description: runsCode, invocations, errors, errorRate, durationMs {p50,p95,max}, cpuMs, memory {maxMb,avgMb,limitMb}, gbHours, series

githubAvailable.description: Whether GitHub is set up on this Perafly (direct push works either way)

includedUsageCents.description: Usage included in the monthly price, in US cents

agentCreditsCents.description: Built-in agent credit granted each month, in US cents

limits.description: Plan limits; null means no limit

rates.description: Metered usage rates beyond the included usage
